microtheory.name: clinical_psychology
microtheory.definition: Diagnosis, formulation, treatment of psychological distress and dysfunction. DSM/ICD nosology; biopsychosocial model; evidence-based treatments (CBT, ACT, DBT, psychodynamic). Substrate analogue: the substrate's failure modes when unchecked + the corrections that restore healthy function map directly to psychopathology + therapy.

concepts.name: generalised_anxiety_disorder
concepts.definition: Persistent excessive worry across multiple domains. Hypervigilance, intolerance of uncertainty. Substrate analogue: substrate's coherence-drive overactive on prediction errors → constant attempted re-derivation.

concepts.name: panic_disorder
concepts.definition: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks + worry about future attacks. Often agoraphobia develops. Substrate analogue: substrate's runaway feedback loop in coherence-drive amplification.

concepts.name: social_anxiety_disorder
concepts.definition: Fear of negative evaluation in social situations. Substrate analogue: in multi-substrate contexts, hyperactive coherence-drive on identity-relevant peer interactions.

concepts.name: ptsd
concepts.definition: Post-traumatic stress disorder. Re-experiencing + avoidance + hyperarousal + negative cognition after trauma. Substrate analogue: substrate Mt with sustained extreme bias from a high-magnitude past event; intrusive event-replay.

concepts.name: ocd_clinical
concepts.definition: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder. Intrusive thoughts (obsessions) + repetitive behaviours (compulsions) to neutralise anxiety. Cortico-striatal-thalamic loop dysfunction. Substrate analogue: substrate's stuck ActionSpec dispatch loop without coverage progress.

concepts.name: major_depressive_disorder
concepts.definition: Persistent low mood + anhedonia + cognitive distortions + sleep/appetite/energy changes. Beck's cognitive triad: negative views of self/world/future. Substrate analogue: substrate state where all drives' targets seem unreachable.

concepts.name: bipolar_disorder
concepts.definition: Cycling between depressive + manic/hypomanic episodes. Substrate analogue: substrate oscillation between low-temperature parsimony + high-temperature curiosity extremes.

concepts.name: dysthymia
concepts.definition: Chronic low-grade depression. Substrate analogue: substrate's persistent baseline frustration without crisis.

concepts.name: schizophrenia
concepts.definition: Psychotic disorder: hallucinations + delusions + disorganised thought + negative symptoms. Dopamine + glutamate dysregulation. Substrate analogue: substrate's misfiring pattern-completion producing high-confidence false retrievals.

concepts.name: delusion
concepts.definition: Fixed false belief held with strong conviction despite disconfirming evidence. Substrate analogue: substrate's identity-protected frozen Mt that resists update.

concepts.name: hallucination
concepts.definition: Perceptual experience without external stimulus. Substrate analogue: substrate's runtime simulation manifesting as perception.

concepts.name: personality_disorder
concepts.definition: Enduring inflexible pattern of inner experience + behaviour deviating from cultural expectations, causing distress + impairment. DSM-5 clusters A/B/C. Substrate analogue: substrate with unbalanced drive-ensemble producing systematic dysfunction.

concepts.name: borderline_personality_disorder
concepts.definition: Cluster B. Instability of self-image + relationships + affect; impulsivity. Linehan's biosocial model. Substrate analogue: substrate's identity field unstable across contexts; high coherence-drive without convergence.

concepts.name: narcissistic_personality_disorder
concepts.definition: Cluster B. Grandiosity + need for admiration + lack of empathy. Substrate analogue: substrate's identity-protection mechanism overactive — value-of-self exaggerated.

concepts.name: trauma_psychological
concepts.definition: Psychological injury from overwhelming event. Acute vs complex. Van der Kolk. Substrate analogue: high-magnitude event creating sustained Mt bias outside normal correction range.

concepts.name: dissociation
concepts.definition: Disruption of integrated functioning — memory, identity, perception, consciousness. Coping mechanism for unprocessable trauma. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt fragmentation — drive-isolation across coherent sub-Mts.

concepts.name: complex_trauma
concepts.definition: Prolonged repeated trauma (typically interpersonal in childhood). Affects identity + emotion regulation + relationships. Herman 1992. Substrate analogue: substrate with foundational Mts shaped by sustained extreme inputs.

concepts.name: psychotherapy
concepts.definition: Talking treatment of psychological distress. Many modalities + traditions. Common factors: relationship, hope, framework, mastery. Substrate analogue: external correction process applied to substrate via collaborative interaction.

concepts.name: cognitive_behavioral_therapy
concepts.definition: Beck + Ellis. Identify + modify cognitive distortions + maladaptive behaviours. Most empirically-supported. Substrate analogue: substrate's derivation_mechanism + correction firing on biased Mts.

concepts.name: acceptance_commitment_therapy
concepts.definition: Hayes. Increase psychological flexibility via acceptance + defusion + present-moment awareness + values-based action. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-balance over rigid optimisation.

concepts.name: dialectical_behavior_therapy
concepts.definition: Linehan. CBT + mindfulness + dialectics. Especially for BPD. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-balance + identity stabilisation procedures.

concepts.name: psychodynamic_therapy
concepts.definition: Insight-oriented. Unconscious patterns + childhood experiences + transference in therapy relationship. Substrate analogue: substrate's introspection over its own opaque Python-side handlers.

concepts.name: exposure_therapy
concepts.definition: Graduated approach to feared stimulus without avoidance. Extinguishes anxiety response. Foa. Substrate analogue: substrate's repeated tick exposure to previously-aversive input → habituation.

concepts.name: mindfulness
concepts.definition: Kabat-Zinn. Non-judgmental present-moment awareness. Mediates trait emotion regulation. Substrate analogue: substrate's ArchitectureCortex assessment-without-correction passes.

concepts.name: therapeutic_alliance
concepts.definition: Bordin 1979. Quality of bond + agreement on goals + agreement on tasks. Predicts therapy outcome more than modality. Substrate analogue: in collaborative correction contexts, quality of substrate-external relationship.

concepts.name: common_factors
concepts.definition: Wampold. Therapy effects largely from shared factors (relationship, expectancy, hope, framework) rather than specific techniques. Substrate analogue: substrate's general intervention efficacy from drive-engagement rather than specific FilterSpec.

rules.name: psychopathology_arises_from_drive_imbalance
rules.head: the substrate's drive ensemble becomes severely imbalanced
rules.body: the substrate exhibits a recognisable pathology pattern — chronic frustration (depression), runaway coherence-seeking (anxiety), stuck-loop dispatch (OCD). Substrate's failure modes catalog psychopathologies.

rules.name: rumination_is_unproductive_coherence_seeking
rules.head: the substrate cycles through the same problem without progress
rules.body: rumination — coherence-drive attempting resolution without information gain. Pathological in depression + anxiety. Substrate's loop without ΔF reduction.

rules.name: avoidance_maintains_anxiety
rules.head: the substrate avoids predicted-aversive inputs
rules.body: the prediction never updates from disconfirming experience; anxiety maintained. Exposure therapy reverses by forcing prediction-error. Substrate's avoided-tick pattern.

rules.name: trauma_creates_persistent_extreme_bias
rules.head: the substrate experiences an overwhelming high-magnitude event
rules.body: the relevant Mts develop sustained extreme bias outside normal correction range. Foundational and resistant to normal updates. Substrate's identity_field × external_field interaction in extreme regime.

rules.name: therapy_provides_external_correction_loop
rules.head: the substrate cannot self-correct a pathological pattern
rules.body: external collaboration provides the correction signal the substrate's internal loop lacks. Therapy = augmented derivation_mechanism.

rules.name: mindfulness_decouples_observation_from_correction
rules.head: the substrate is in pathological self-correction loop
rules.body: mindfulness — observation without correction firing — breaks the loop by reducing drive-amplitude. Substrate's assess-without-act pass.
